mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as the rate is continuously observed.
failure_condition: The historical rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 20-day returns in periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Labor market tightness (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals an overheating economy, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when UNRATE > 4.0% are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the historical rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%) and inflation accelerates (CPIAUCSL > 0.3% MoM), aggressive monetary tightening expectations drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the historical rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 250), reduced liquidity and higher discount rates drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the historical rank IC for the regime signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as INDPRO is continuously observed.
failure_condition: The historical rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the 20-day returns in periods when INDPRO > 105.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing market conditions (HOUST < 1200.0) signal reduced consumer confidence and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when HOUST < 1200.0 are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the historical rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) rises (RSAFS > 0.3% MoM) and housing starts (HOUST) fall (HOUST < 1200.0), housing market correction expectations drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the historical rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the historical rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
